Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice, and leaving a stove on by accident is inadvertent conduct without intent to burn the house.

Q5966.reason: The cardiac cycle is defined as diastole (relaxation and filling) followed by systole (contraction and ejection).

Q8294.reason: Ice is less dense than liquid water because hydrogen bonds form an open crystalline lattice, so increasing pressure favors the liquid and gives the negative slope.
